hotels.title: Award-Winning Mornington Peninsula Haven with Daily Breakfast, A$100 Dining Credit & Ocean Views
hotels.description: From championship golf to acclaimed fine dining, this five-star resort offers unparalleled experiences on the southernmost tip of one of Victoria’s most spectacular headlands. Ease into the rhythm of relaxation, moving effortlessly from the indoor pool to the tennis courts before venturing into the rugged beauty of the Mornington Peninsula, where top-tier wineries, bushwalks and hot springs await. With A$100 drinks and dining credit included, you’ll be perfectly placed to sample your way across the resort’s multiple acclaimed dining venues. Don’t miss an evening of fine dining at Cape, a former AGFG Chef Hat winner, serving an innovative French-inspired tasting menu in an ambient, open-kitchen setting. Golfers will adore RACV Cape Schanck Resort’s championship 18-hole course, defined by bush-lined fairways and sweeping views over the shimmering Bass Strait. Head to One Spa for treatments designed to set your worries adrift, or spend your days exploring the Mornington Peninsula’s picture-perfect towns, coves and beaches.
